newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea says to absorb one trln won.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea says to absorb one trln won.

text.p: South Korea's central Bank of Korea (BOK) said on Tuesday it would absorb one trillion won through repurchase agreements today.
A BOK official said cash liquidity was excessive due to recent money supplies from state spending.
"Cash liquidity with banks looked excessive because of money release from the state budget," said the official.
He said banks had about three trillion won in excess of their reserve obligations in the last 15 days.
He said 500 to 600 billion won would be supplied today fron the government budget.
The central bank said the money absorption today would be returned to the banking system on Wednesday when about 1.5 trillion won worth of taxes were scheduled to be collected.
